parse.wikitext:
== Birdhouses and Guardians ==

{{Checklist|title=Section 8|
* Bank, withdraw Boots of Lightness, Chronicle, Bronze Pickaxe, Player Owned House Tab, GP, 3 Pots of Flour, Bucket, Pie Dish, 3 Redberries
* Break POH Tab
** Mine 10 Clay and 4 Copper at [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rimmington_mine Rimmington Mine]
* Pick up 1 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Snape_grass Snape Grass] west of the Crafting Guild
* Prepare and cook until you have 1 cooked Redberry Pie at the range above the fishing shop in Port Sarim
** Make 1 Pastry Dough with a Pot of Flour and a Bucket of Water
** Make 1 Pie Shell with a Pastry Dough and Pie Dish
** Make 1 Uncooked Berry Pie with a Pie Shell and Redberries
* Draynor Village Diango, buy 20 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Teleport_card Teleport Cards]
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ethically_Acquired_Antiquities Ethically Acquired Antiquities]
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Death_on_the_Isle Death on the Isle]
** Collect the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Costume_needle Costume Needle] after the quest
* Bank all except gp
* Buy a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Greenman%27s_ale Greenman's Ale] from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Sunlight%27s_Sanctum Sunlight's Sanctum]
* Charter from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Aldarin Aldarin] to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Civitas_illa_Fortis Civitas illa Fortis]
* Make your way to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tal_Teklan Tal Teklan]
* Buy from the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tal_Teklan_Rune_Shop Rune Shop]
** 15 Mind Rune Packs
** 80 Air Rune Packs (10 per world)
** 15 Water Rune Packs
** 5 Earth Rune Packs
** 5 Fire Rune Packs
** 200 Body Runes
** 300 Chaos Runes
** 100 Death Runes
* Buy from the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dyes_to_Die_For Dye Shop]
** 9 Yellow Dyes
** 1 Blue Dye
** 7 Red Dyes
** 1 Orange Dye
* Bank all, withdraw GP, Redberry Pie, Stew, and Research Notes
* Home Teleport
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rune_Mysteries Rune Mysteries]
* Port Sarim, Buy 2000 Feathers from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Gerrant Gerrant] via packs (5 packs per world)
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Knight%27s_Sword The Knight's Sword] until You've given [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Thurgo Thurgo] his Redberry Pie
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Client_of_Kourend Client of Kourend]. Destroy lamps
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Queen_of_Thieves Queen of Thieves] until you are asked to search Councillor Hughes' Home
* Bank in Hosidius, withdraw GP
* Buy from the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Vannah Vannah Farming Shop] east of the bank and fill up the Tool Leprechaun to the south
** 10 Rakes
** 10 Seed Dibbers
** 10 Spades
** 5 Gardening Trowels
** 1 Watering Can
** 5 Farming Pot Packs
** 5 Basket Packs
** 10 Empty Bucket Packs
** 5 Sack Packs
* Bank in Hosidius. Deposit everything except [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chronicle Chronicle]
* Steal from the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fruit_Stall Hosidius Fruit Stall] until 2 Jangerberries, 2 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Golovanova_fruit_top Golovanova Fruit Tops], all Strange Fruits, and 52,212 Thieving XP
** Optionally get to 82,033 XP here if you don't want to blackjack for a few levels
** Use strange fruits at your discretion
}}

{{Checklist|title=Section 9|
* Bank for gp, Bronze Pickaxe, [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chronicle Chronicle]
* Time to buy items, bank them as needed
* Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Thessalia%27s_Fine_Clothes. Thessalia's Fine Clothes]
** 5 Leather Bodies
** Priest Gown (top and bottom)
** 1 Brown Apron
** 1 Pink Skirt
* Buy 1 Air Staff and 1 Fire Staff from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Zaff%27s_Superior_Staffs! Zaff's Superior Staffs!]
* Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Lowe%27s_Archery_Emporium Lowe's Archery Emporium]
** 1 Oak Longbow
** 1 Willow Shor[https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Twisted_bow Twisted Bow]
** 300 Mithril Arrows
** 5 Crossbows
* Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Horvik%27s_Armour_Shop. Horvik's Armour Shop]
** 1 Iron Chainbody
** 2 Steel Chainbodies
** 1 Steel Platebody
** 1 Black Platebody
** 1 Mithril Platebody
** 1 set of Studded Armour (top & legs)
* Bank everything except Pickaxe
* Mine & Bank 3 full inventories of Rune Essence at [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Aubury Aubury]
* Bank, withdraw Falador Tablet, Bucket of Sand, Soda Ash, Spade, Chest Key
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Knight%27s_Sword The Knight's Sword] until you've collected the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Portrait Portrait]
* Turn Soda Ash and Sand into Molten Glass at the furnace
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Pirate%27s_Treasure Pirate's Treasure]
* Bank everything, withdraw an Air Talisman and 27 Rune Essence
* Make 2 trips to craft Air Runes (54 essence total)
}}

{{Checklist|title=Section 10|
* Bank, withdraw GP, Staff of Air, Chicken, Blue Dye, 2 Iron Ore, Raw Beef, Rat Meat, 4 Copper Ore, 6 Clay, 1 Cheese, 6 Wine, Orange Dye, Mind Runes
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Doric%27s_Quest Doric's Quest]
* Using Air Strike, safespot a Bear to the east for meat and fur
* Buy an Adamant Pickaxe and Rune Pickaxe in [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dwarven_Mine Dwarven Mines]
* Complete Quests
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Goblin_Diplomacy Goblin Diplomacy]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Druidic_Ritual Druidic Ritual]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Witch%27s_House Witch's House]
{{Youtube|54ltDNUdAJc}}
* Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Jatix Jatix]
** 1 Eye of Newt Pack
** 1 Water-filled Vial Pack
** 1 Empty Vial
** 1 Vial of Water
** 1 Pestle and Mortar
* Start [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fishing_Contest Fishing Contest] (First Step)
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chronicle Chronicle], Bank in Varrock
* Clean all Herbs in Bank and make Attack Potions until 10 Herblore
* withdraw Pestle and Mortar, Vial, Tinderbox, Charcoal, Cup of Tea and 2 Ropes
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Dig_Site The Dig Site]
** Obtain items along the way
* Varrock, bank everything
* Do Museum finds until you get all relics and clean necklace for Digsite Pendant
* Bank, withdraw GP, 2 Iron Bars, POH Tab, Portrait, 5 Cakes, Bronze Pickaxe, [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chronicle Chronicle]
* Break POH Tab and Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Knight%27s_Sword The Knight's Sword]
* Lumby tele, deposit all, withdraw GP, Shears, 3 Oak Logs, 10 Steel Nails, Hammer, Chisel, Knife, Ghost's Skull, Tinderbox
* Run to the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/H.A.M._Hideout H.A.M Hideout] to the west and pickpocket members for a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rusty_sword Rusty Sword] and [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Polished_buttons Polished Buttons], drop the rest
* Shear 1 Sheep for Wool
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Restless_Ghost Restless Ghost]
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Feud The Fued] until you've obtained the Desert Disguise
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dommik%27s_Crafting_Store. Crafting Store], Buy one of each mould, 10 Thread, and Mithril Platelegs
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Sleeping_Giants Sleeping Giants], banking everything during the quest
}}

{{Checklist|title=Section 11|
*Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Shantay_Pass_Shop Shantay Pass Shop] and bank:
** 9 Bronze Bars
** 2 sets of Desert Clothes (1 pair of boots only)
** 16 Bucket Packs
** 4 Bowls of Water
** 20 Buckets of Water
** 13 Waterskins
*Make 4 Soft Clay at bank chest using the Buckets of Water
* Equip Desert Clothes, Air Staff, Leather Gloves
* withdraw gp, 3 Waterskins, Mind Runes, Chaos Runes, 3 Bronze Bars, Knife, Pickaxe, Hammer, 50 Feathers, 10 Wines
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Tourist_Trap The Tourist Trap]
** XP Rewards on Thieving
{{Youtube|VFxB4zWqrd8}}
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Feud The Fued]
** Collect (extra) 1 Ugthanki Dung, 3 Beers, 3 Vodkas
** Train until 17 Magic by safespotting bandits and using Bolt Spells for [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tough_Guy The Tough Guy]
* Expected 52 Agility - If you aren't, run a few laps of the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Al_Kharid_Rooftop_Course Al-Kharid Rooftop Course]
* Passive - [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Wilderness_Agility_Course Wilderness Agility] to 72
** You will need money, do this ASAP for some gp.  Always keep 500k~ as a buffer
** We won't need 72 until much later, no need to rush!
** Only alch rune items when you need GP. Save as many mith/addy items as you can for Giants Foundry if possible
** Stay in the "Agility FC" CC & Discord whenever you can dedicated 2+ Hours to running. This will be your Agility method until 72. Look at their discord for details as it can change
** If you don't want to risk Hardcore status, consider Earth Battlestaves for gp and Rooftops for Agility Training
* Carpet to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Pollnivneach Pollnivneach] with GP & Blackjack, Blackjack until 50 Thieving, buying wines from shop
{{Youtube|6wuG8IvxHbM}}
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rogues%27_Den Rogue's Den] in Burthorpe, deposit everything except GP and buy
** 75 Lockpicks
** 25 Ropes
* Buy from the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Toad_and_Chicken bar upstairs]
** 6 Asgarnian Ale
** 39 Wizard's Mind Bombs
** 12 Dwarven Stouts
* Collect the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Rogue_equipment Rogue's Outfit] while cooking to restore Energy
* Cook all fish
** Minimum 10 Cooked Trout, 15 Cooked Salmon
* Passive - [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Wealthy_citizen Wealthy Citizens] in Varlamore to 71 Thieving
** Very afk and you get gp
** We won't need this for a long time, no need to rush!
** You can also do Arteglass or raw [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Stealing_artefacts Stealing Artefacts] with any skilling passively 
*** EX: Cutting gems, blowing glass, alching, etc
{{Youtube|StgC4H2eN6s}}
}}

{{Checklist|title=Section 12|
* withdraw 3 Planks, 1 Bronze Bar, and 1 Molten Glass, Adamant Axe, 3 Cakes
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Observatory_Quest Observatory Quest]
** Outside pick up + decant for minimum 5x 4-dose potions
* Complete one game of [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fishing_Trawler Fishing Trawler], chopping on the deck
* Charter to Catherby, bank and withdraw gp
* Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Trader_Crewmember Trader Crewmembers]
** 1600 Soda Ash
** 600 Pineapples
** 9 Buckets of Slime
** 102 Swamp Paste
** 1 Hammer
** 4 Tinderboxes
* Bank, withdraw GP, 2 Buckets, Knife, Tinderbox, Feathers, Empty Pot, [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Garlic Garlic], Spade, Fishing Pass
* Buy 1 Candle to the west, pick up [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Insect_repellent Insect Repellant], and get 2 [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Beehive Buckets of Wax]
* Run to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/McGrubor%27s_Wood McGrubbor's Woods] and get 3 Red Vine Worms
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fishing_Contest Fishing Contest] until you get the Trophy
* Complete Quests
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Murder_Mystery Murder Mystery]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Elemental_Workshop_I Elemental Workshop 1]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Elemental_Workshop_I Elemental Workshop 2]
* Bank everything at Seers, withdraw only Fly Fishing Rod and Feathers
* Fly Fish north of Seers bank until 35 Fishing, banking the fish
* Tele & bank at Edgeville
* Cut all Gems and [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Jewellery make Jewelry]
** Make 1 Sapphire Necklace and a Silver Sickle
** Make sure you're 31 Crafting at the end of this
* Deposit all, withdraw a Knife
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Enter_the_Abyss Enter the Abyss Miniquest] until you're done in the Wilderness (First Step)
* Pull lever and run to Mage Bank
* withdraw gp and Sapphire Necklace
*Buy from the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Lundail%27s_Arena-side_Rune_Shop. Rune Shop]
** 1301 Water Runes
** 650 Nature Runes (50 per world)
** 200 Cosmic Runes (20 per world)
** 2050 Law Runes (buy down to 150)
*Enchant a Games Necklace
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_Slayer_I Dragon Slayer 1] until you've spoken to the Guildmaster (First Step)
* Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Scavvo Scavvo]
** Green D'hide Chaps
** Green D'hide Vambraces
** Rune Longsword
* Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Valaine Valaine]
** Black Platelegs
** Black Full Helm
* Run to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mage_Training_Arena Mage Training Arena]
}}

{{Checklist|title=Section 13|
* Bank all, withdraw [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chronicle Chronicle], Air Staff, Earth Staff, Water Runes, Law Runes, Nature Runes
* Do the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mage_Training_Arena/Creature_Graveyard Graveyard Room] until 33 Magic
* Do the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mage_Training_Arena/Telekinetic_Theatre Telekinetic Room] for 56 Magic or 1150 Telekinetic Points, whichever comes first
** Make sure you're 56 magic at the end - Do an alternative if you get 801 points first
* Games Necklace to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Barbarian_Assault Barbarian Assault]
* Unlock the minigame teleport by viewing the tutorial with [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Captain_Cain Captain Cain]
* Bank, withdraw GP, Rope, 6 Logs, Air Staff, 150 Chaos Runes (Mind Runes if low), 7 Wine, Hammer, Games Necklace
* Start [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Alfred_Grimhand%27s_Barcrawl Barcrawl]. Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Waterfall_Quest Waterfall Quest] until you require [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Glarial%27s_pebble Glarial's Pebble]
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dwarf_Cannon Dwarf Cannon] until you have found Lollk
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fight_Arena Fight Arena] and [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tree_Gnome_Village Tree Gnome Village]
{{Youtube|-_u1Hj5c6jM}}
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Waterfall_Quest Waterfall Quest] until you've collected [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Glarial%27s_pebble Glarial's Pebble]
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Grand_Tree Grand Tree] until you've spoken with [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/King_Narnode_Shareen King Shareen] (First Step)
* Bank in Tree - 2nd floor west, Deposit all and withdraw GP
*Buy from the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Grand_Tree_Groceries Grand Tree Groceries]
** 3 Pots of Flour
** 1 Gnome Spice
** 10 Onion
** 30 Potatoes
** 10 Cabbage
** 4 Cheese
** 2 Orange
** 1 Cocktail Shaker
** 1 Cocktail Glass
** 2 Lemon
** 300 Pineapples
** 2 Dwellberries
** 140 Chocolate Bars
** 6 Buckets of Milk
** 120 Various Extra Produce items
}}

{{Checklist|title=Section 14|
* Bank, withdraw Chronicle, Air Staff, Priest Gown top and bottom, Games Necklace, gp, Death Runes, Dwellberries, Rope, Spade, Chocolate Dust, Bucket of Milk, Snape Grass, 6 Air Runes, 6 Earth Runes, 6 Water Runes, 10 Food
* Without Banking, complete Quests
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Plague_City Plague City]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Biohazard Biohazard]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Waterfall_Quest Waterfall Quest] (Drop stuff outside)
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Grand_Tree Grand Tree]
* At this point in the guide there will be less defined bank withdrawls provided. withdraw quest helper items as necessary
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ardougne_Diary#Easy Ardy Easy Diary] & use lamp on Mining
* Complete Quests
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fishing_Contest Fishing Contest]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Enter_the_Abyss Enter the Abyss Miniquest]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Priest_in_Peril Priest in Peril], moving POH to Hosidius while in Varrock
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Nature_Spirit Nature Spirit]
}}

{{Checklist|title=Section 15|
* Bank, withdraw Adamant Scimitar, Air Staff, Death Runes, GP, 2 Strange Fruit, 10+ Salmon
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Twilight%27s_Promise Twilights Promise]
** Kite the boss with magic primarily
* Passive - Gemstone Crab Unlocked for 90+ Combats
** We won't need strong stats for about 100~ steps, no need to rush!
** Range training later.  For now, 60 Attack First, 65 Strength, 65 Attack, 45 Defence, 60 Defence, then 80 Strength, 80 Attack, 70 Defence, 95 Strength
** When 60 Attack, rush [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Monkey_Madness_I Monkey Madness 1[. When 45 Defence, try and find a group to get Fighter Torso or buy one with BA services
* Quetzal to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Auburnvale Auburnvale]
** Turn 100 Teak Logs into Planks at the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Sawmill#Auburnvale Sawmill]
** Buy 1000 Steel Nails and 1 Iron Nail
* Bank, withdraw Air Runes, Chaos Runes, Water Staff, Chronicle
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_Slayer_I Dragon Slayer 1] until you've obtained an [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Anti-dragon_shield Anti-dragon Shield]
* Water Bolt [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Blue_dragon Blue Dragons] in [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_Nest Dragons Nest] near Tal Teklan for 100 Bones
** Buy more Chaos Runes as needed from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tal_Teklan_Rune_Shop Tal Teklan Rune Shop]
* Complete Quests
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Lost_City Lost City]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Cook%27s_Assistant Cook's Assistant]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Recipe_for_Disaster/Freeing_the_Goblin_generals Recipe for Disaster - Freeing the Goblin Generals]
** [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Ides_of_Milk The Ides of Milk] (1k xp lamp on Prayer)
* Get 44+ Prayer by using the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chaos_Temple_(hut) Wilderness Chaos Temple]
**Ferox tele, withdraw Dueling Ring and 28 Dragon Bones
**Run to [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Chaos_Temple_(hut) Wilderness Chaos Temple], use bones fast. Hover logout
* Downstairs in Lumbridge Cellar, Buy from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Culinaromancer%27s_Chest Culianaromancer's Chest]
** 23 Spice
** 1 Pot of Cream
** 5 Pots of Flour
** 8 Buckets of Milk
** 4 Eggs
** 2 Pie Dishes
** 5 Cheese
* Prepare 2 Uncooked Redberry Pies and 1 Bread Dough
** Make 2 Pastry Dough with a Pot of Flour and a Bucket of Water
** Make 2 Pie Shell with a Pastry Dough and Pie Dish
** Make 2 Uncooked Berry Pie with a Pie Shell and Redberries
* Cook 1 Bread and 2 Redberry Pies on the range on ground floor of Lumby Castle
* Add Nettles to two bowls of water and cook it to make 2 Nettle Tea
** Leave one Redberry in bank
* Cook until 32 cooking
** Keep 10 Cooked Trout in bank
* Run to Draynor and (hop) [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Draynor_Seed_Market Buy all seeds] until you have 11,000 seeds total
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fairytale_I_-_Growing_Pains Fairytale Part 1]
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Fairytale_II_-_Cure_a_Queen Fairytale Part 2] until you've spoken to the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Co-ordinator Co-Ordinator]
** Fairy Rings Unlocked!
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Garden_of_Death Garden of Death]
* Bank, withdraw Air Runes, Earth Runes, Law Runes, Tarromin Seeds (or any plantable herb seeds), Feathers, and Knife. Games Necklace to Barb Assault
* Start [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Barbarian_Training Barbarian Training] for Fishing and complete it
* Start [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Barbarian_Training Barbarian Training] for bare-handed planting
** Use Hosidius Herb Patch (home tele) to plant any herb seed. Complete bare-handed planting back at Otto
* Turn all possible [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Sapling seeds into Saplings] at bank
}}

{{Checklist|title=Section 16|
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/The_Giant_Dwarf Giant Dwarf]
** Buy ores from [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Ore_seller. Blast Furnace Ore Seller] & Superheat/smelt to make Bars
** Do not hop worlds during this quest
* Buy 6 Limestone Bricks from the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Stonemason Stonemason]
* Smelt at the Blast Furnace
** 20 Steel Bars
** 20 Iron Bars
** 50 Silver Bars
** 108 Gold Bars
* Tele to Edgeville and [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Jewellery make Jewelry]. Keep 10 Gold Bars in bank
** Sapphire - 1 Amulet of Magic, 10 Rings of Recoil, & rest into Games Necklaces
** Emerald - Rings of Dueling
** Ruby - 1 Amulet of Strength total & rest into Digsite Necklaces
* Bank, withdrawing a Bucket of Water, Ring of Dueling, Law Runes, Air Runes, Fire Runes
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Temple_of_the_Eye Temple of the Eye]
* Varrock Museum speak with the [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Historian_Minas Clerk] upstairs until you're at 100 Kudos
** Lamp on Herblore
* Progress [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Bone_Voyage Bone Voyage] until you're finished at the Woodcutting Guild
** Make 50 Mahogany Logs into Planks
** Make 27 Oak Logs into Planks
** Buy an Iron Axe, Mithril Axe, and a Rune Axe
* Bank, withdraw gp and a Chef's Hat. Run to Cooking Guild west of Varrock and fill inventory with garden pies
* Bank, withdraw 1 Iron Bar, 2 Oak Planks, 5 Nails, Hammer
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Bone_Voyage Bone Voyage] & build the bank
* Unlock [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Mycelium_Transportation_System Magic Mushtree System] (Skip South)
* Bank, withdraw Saw, Hammer, 4 Oak Planks, 1 Molten Glass, 4 Steel Bars, Air Staff, Earth Runes, Law Runes
* Teleport to house and make a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Workshop Workshop Room]
** Crafting Table 1
** Crafting Table 2
** Then Craft 4 Clockworks while sitting at the Table
* Complete your first [https://imgur.com/a/Ddud8Wd Birdhouse & Seaweed run], including 4 clockworks for first run
** Wait [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Underwater Underwater] for Seaweed Ppores when you're afk
*** To get there, take the boat at the North of the island, row out to Sea, then Dive
* Mine 2,000 Volcanic Ash
* Passive - Start Herb Runs to use all seeds (full route with Trees, Fruit Trees, Herbs)
** [https://imgur.com/a/NR3s2N2 Herb Run Inventory]
*** Trees in run:  4
*** Fruit Trees in run:  4
*** Herbs in run:  6
*** Fairy Ring ALQ North (drop pineapples to make ultracompost in bin)
*** Catherby Herb
*** Bank for Saplings
*** Catherby Fruit
*** Charter to Brimhaven Fruit
*** House Tele (Hosidius) Herb
*** Varlamore Herb
*** Falador Tree
*** Falador Herb
*** Ardy Herb
*** Varrock Tree
*** Lumbridge Tree
*** Spirit Tree (2) Tree & Fruit
*** Spirit Tree (1) Fruit
*** Make sure to collect 18 branches from willow trees
* Passive - When you're 54 Farming, do Tithe Farm until Herb Sack and Autoweed
{{Youtube|AImGJepWbkw}}
* Passive - Complete Birdhouse & Seaweed runs on cooldown until 12,000 Seaweed & 70 Hunter
* Complete [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Death_Plateau Death Plateau] and [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Troll_Stronghold Troll Stronghold]
* Bank, withdraw Chisel and Adamant Pickaxe
* [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Guardians_of_the_Rift/Strategies Guardians Of The Rift] until 60 Runecrafting and a [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Catalytic_talisman Catalytic Talisman] or [https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Death_talisman Death Talisman]
** Maintain Birdhouse, Seaweed, and Farming Runs.  You can minigame teleport back to GOTR
}}
